## Purpose

Describe the user-facing and statistical consequence of this change.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated focused tests.
- [ ] Compared statistical changes with a direct underlying-package call or a verified formula.
- [ ] Ran `R CMD check` with zero unexpected errors, warnings, or notes.
- [ ] Updated documentation and `NEWS.md` when behavior changed.
- [ ] Used only synthetic or de-identified data.
- [ ] Preserved effect direction, reference groups, variance assumptions, and reporting scales unless explicitly documented.

## Reproduction

Provide the shortest code needed to verify the change.
